title: From prototype to production: Engineering agents with Agent DLC
summary: Agents stall between demo and release when teams lack a repeatable way to measure how good an agent is and whether the last change helped. This post covers three agent properties that break traditional CI/CD, a measured case where an aggregate metric hides a coverage gap, and Age
reason: AWS blog post is educational commentary about engineering/evaluating agents in production; it announces no named model release, research artifact, business event, policy action, or new open-source tool/framework release.
